Priya K.: hey! quick snag on my first day. I can view the company home page but when I click the "Eng -> Onboarding" space I get a 403. I'm on the contractor account — do contractors need a different permission to edit templates?

Tara (DevEx): hi @Priya K. 83 welcome! Contractors by default get view access only. If you need edit rights for a short period (e.g., pairing on a doc), we grant a timeboxed editor role. Fill the edit request form and pick 'Contractor - Temporary Editor'. Link: https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request

Priya K.: thanks. FYI the form asks for "owner approval". who typically signs off for infra docs?

Hector (Eng): hi, infra pages are owned by the Infra Platform guild. Usually the owner field on the doc lists the approver. If the page hasn't got an owner, ping @Hector or @Olivia and we'll triage.

Olivia D.: sequence we use: duplicate the template, make changes, open a small PR-like review by putting the link in #devex or pinging the owner. We prefer not to edit a shared template in place so we avoid accidental global changes.

Priya K.: good call. How do we track template versions? I've seen old copies floating in team folders before.

Tara (DevEx): we use a simple meta pattern at the top of every template: Version, Last edited, Owner, Compatibility (which teams). Example block we ask people to keep updated:

```
Version: v1.2
Last edited: 2026-02-10
Owner: Infra Platform (hector@redwood.com)
Compatibility: Dedicated, Private
```

Also, update the change log section and add a link in the Onboarding index under "Recent template updates". We run notion-sync-bot weekly to generate the index from those metadata fields.

Priya K.: cool. Are there naming rules for contractor-created onboarding docs? want to avoid duplicates.

Olivia D.: yes — naming: [Team] - [DocType] - [ShortDesc] - [OwnerInitials] - [Temp]. E.g., "Infra - OnboardingChecklist - CloudInit - PK - Temp". When it graduates, remove the "Temp" and drop initials.

Priya K.: thanks. last thing: I tried to share a doc link with a teammate outside the company and Notion blocked it with "External sharing disabled". Is that expected?

Tara (DevEx): external sharing is disabled org-wide for security. For audited sharing (e.g., with enterprise partners), open a ticket with Security + legal and include the reason and duration. We can enable a special share link for the page but it requires approval.

Priya K.: perfect, submitted the form and put the temp page in my team folder. thanks everyone, saved me a ton of time :raised_hands:
